definitions.en: Concentrates continuity, focal coherence and system-level self-reference without assigning identity or destiny.
definitions.zh-Hans: 集中连续性、核心一致性与系统层级的自我参照，不赋予身份或命运。

definitions.en: Tracks regulation, response rhythm, retention and adjustment patterns without asserting personality.
definitions.zh-Hans: 记录调节、反应节律、保留与适应模式，不断言人格。

definitions.en: Organizes differentiation, exchange, comparison and transmission of information.
definitions.zh-Hans: 组织差异辨识、交换、比较与信息传递。

definitions.en: Organizes valuation, selective attraction, preference coherence and exchange conditions.
definitions.zh-Hans: 组织价值判断、选择性吸引、偏好一致性与交换条件。

definitions.en: Organizes directed effort, mobilization, separation, assertion and immediate action.
definitions.zh-Hans: 组织定向用力、动员、分离、边界主张与即时行动。

definitions.en: Organizes enlargement of scope, synthesis, opportunity scanning and contextual integration.
definitions.zh-Hans: 组织范围扩展、综合、机会扫描与情境整合。

definitions.en: Organizes limits, sequencing, accountability, load-bearing structure and long-duration stability.
definitions.zh-Hans: 组织限制、排序、责任、承重结构与长期稳定。

definitions.en: Organizes discontinuity, divergence, novel variation and pattern-breaking transitions.
definitions.zh-Hans: 组织不连续、分化、新变异与打破既有模式的转折。

definitions.en: Organizes permeability, diffusion, ambiguity and contextual blending without treating uncertainty as fact.
definitions.zh-Hans: 组织渗透、扩散、模糊与情境融合，不把不确定性当作事实。

definitions.en: Organizes concentration, elimination, deep restructuring and irreversible reconfiguration pressure.
definitions.zh-Hans: 组织集中、淘汰、深层重组与不可逆的重构压力。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward initiation, emergence and first movement.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向启动、出现与第一步。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward consolidation, retention and sustained material continuity.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向巩固、保留与持续承载。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward comparison, branching, exchange and information linkage.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向比较、分支、交换与信息连接。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward containment, protection, memory and boundary-based continuity.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向容纳、保护、记忆与有边界的连续。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward centering, expression, visibility and coherent output.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向中心化、表达、可见性与一致输出。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward discrimination, correction, maintenance and functional refinement.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向辨析、修正、维护与功能精炼。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward reciprocity, calibration, counterpart awareness and coordination.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向互惠、校准、对方意识与协调。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward concentration, penetration, binding and transformative pressure.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向集中、深入、绑定与转化压力。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward exploration, extension, synthesis and larger orientation.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向探索、延展、综合与更大尺度的方向。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward sequencing, formalization, responsibility and durable structure.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向排序、制度化、责任与耐久结构。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward networks, distributed coordination, differentiation and systemic change.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向网络、分布式协调、差异化与系统变化。

definitions.en: Directs energy toward permeability, synthesis, transition and boundary softening.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将运动导向渗透、综合、过渡与边界软化。

definitions.en: Domain of immediate interface, embodied entry, orientation and visible presence.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于即时接口、具身进入、定位与可见呈现的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of resources, retained value, possession conditions and material support.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于资源、保留价值、持有条件与物质支持的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of local exchange, communication, learning loops and near-environment navigation.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于局部交换、沟通、学习回路与近域导航的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of roots, private base, shelter, inherited foundation and internal anchoring.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于根基、私域基础、庇护、承继基础与内部锚定的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of creation, experimentation, play, generative output and visible expression.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于创造、实验、游戏、生成性输出与可见表达的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of maintenance, routines, service, workload, adjustment and operational health.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于维护、日常流程、服务、负荷、调整与运行健康的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of counterparts, agreements, one-to-one exchange and negotiated relation.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于对方、协议、一对一交换与协商关系的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of shared resources, dependency, binding, transfer, loss and structural transformation.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于共享资源、依赖、绑定、转移、损耗与结构转化的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of worldview, extended learning, distant context, principles and interpretive frameworks.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于世界观、延伸学习、远域情境、原则与解释框架的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of public position, trajectory, responsibility, institutional role and visible contribution.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于公共位置、轨迹、责任、制度角色与可见贡献的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of networks, groups, shared futures, distributed resources and collective coordination.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于网络、群体、共同未来、分布式资源与集体协调的现实领域。

definitions.en: Domain of background processes, withdrawal, closure, recovery, permeability and unobserved load.
definitions.zh-Hans: 关于后台过程、退隐、结束、恢复、渗透与未被看见负荷的现实领域。

definitions.en: Marks two functions operating in close angular co-location; it indicates concentration, not a guaranteed outcome.
definitions.zh-Hans: 表示两个功能在接近的角距中同位运行；它表示集中，不保证任何结果。

definitions.en: Marks a counter-position that makes polarity, comparison and reciprocal tension structurally visible.
definitions.zh-Hans: 表示对置，使极性、比较与相互张力在结构上变得可见。

definitions.en: Marks a geometry of relatively low-friction coordination between two projected functions.
definitions.zh-Hans: 表示两个投射功能之间相对低摩擦的协调几何。

definitions.en: Marks a geometry of constraint, friction and required adjustment between two projected functions.
definitions.zh-Hans: 表示两个投射功能之间的约束、摩擦与需要调整的几何。

definitions.en: Marks a supportive geometric linkage that can facilitate coordination when engaged.
definitions.zh-Hans: 表示一种支持性的几何连接，在被实际调用时可促进协调。

definitions.en: Marks the north end of the true lunar nodal axis as a directional development reference only; it is not a destiny or past-life claim.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将真实月交点轴的北端作为发展方向参照；它不是命运或前世断言。

definitions.en: Marks the south end of the true lunar nodal axis as the complementary counter-direction reference only; it is not a destiny or past-life claim.
definitions.zh-Hans: 将真实月交点轴的南端作为互补的反向参照；它不是命运或前世断言。
